function: Excluded (above_phy): the RL policy only sets user priority weights (scheduling) from queue and channel state; beamforming and SIC come from non-learned BB or CC-TLG (p. 5).
notes: Reason above_phy. p. 5: the RL "controls the priority weights of users in the long-term stage" while beamforming and SIC are optimized "using an iterative algorithm" (BB-based or CC-TLG with SCA, pp. 7-11); p. 3 calls it "the resource scheduling problem in the cluster-free NOMA with hard-latency constraint". Single-stage RL on beamforming and SIC does not converge (p. 14). Borderline for the reviewer: the weights set the WSR operating point and so the beamformer only indirectly; if read as area 3, note the custom exponentially correlated Rayleigh channel (p. 12), the Q-weighted scheduler and SAC baselines (p. 13), and no code link.
